description: As of 2016 Mexico's suicide rate was 5.2 per 100,000, up from 2.2 in 1990, with the male rate at 8.7 against 2.2 for women - close to four times. Male rates have consistently run around four times female rates.
energy_note: Four to one, and the total is rising.

aspect: EXAMPLE - migration raises it on both sides of the line
description: Borges et al. (2009) found elevated risk of suicidal ideation among Mexicans with a family member in the United States, among Mexican-born immigrants who arrived aged 12 or younger, and among US-born Mexican Americans - with attempt risk also higher for those with family in the US.
energy_note: Having a brother in Texas raises his own risk, measurably.

aspect: The thing that would help is the thing he will not do
description: Help-seeking is the recognised protective behaviour and is precisely what the norm in MEN-002 suppresses.
energy_note: The treatment and the prohibition are the same subject.
